rows.what_the_ink_shows: The margin beside the boxed comparison visibly says à vérifier followed by a dotted continuation. The box contains xi with subscript n, an equals sign, and delta with subscript n applied to the previously named class. The next line calls delta_n the opérateur cobord; beneath it is the cohomology map. The following line explicitly says associé à la suite exacte de Kummer, followed by the sequence 0 to nE to E to E to 0, with n id_E over the middle map. The page therefore supplies a Kummer-boundary context, with no Fourier attribution written here. See crops/57_scan144_L1310_comparison.png, crops/57_scan144_L1310_margin.png, crops/57_scan144_L1310_cobord.png, and crops/57_scan144_L1310_kummer.png.
